messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up — we need a compact runbook for supplier onboarding + press pacing for the marketplace launch. Goal: clear handoff for SI test tenants, partner badges, and a staggered press calendar.
jamal (pm): +1. Can we lock owners and a hard timeline by EOD Wed? Main asks: asset drop, integration test window, and embargo windows.
tom (marketing): I'll own press cadence and blog schedule. Need embargo windows from legal and final hero assets by Tue COB.
alex (comms): Legal needs the exact quote language and partner logo approvals by Monday. Also confirm whether partners want co-authored blog or partner spotlight.
sara (eng): From infra side — need a list of partner integration endpoints and expected call volumes. Can we get a minimal test plan so we can provision staging tenants?
kevin (si-ops): We have three SI integrators who need 48h notice for staging access. Proposed staging window: Fri 09:00–18:00 PT, and a cutover dry-run next Wed morning.
maria (partnerships): Great. Proposal summary (short):
```
- Asset owners: marketing -> tom, logos -> alex, partner onboarding -> jamal
- Staging windows: Fri 09:00–18:00 PT (SI smoke tests)
- Dry-run: Wed 08:30–10:00 PT (release team)
- Embargo: Public announcement Thu 14:00 PT (hold until partner approvals)
- Tenant provisioning: ops to create partner tenants 24h before staging window
```
jamal (pm): Filling gaps: partner readiness checklist items — API keys, SSO configs, sample dataset, and a focused smoke test script. I'll publish a short checklist doc and tag owners. Link: https://go/repo/partner-checklist (draft)
tom (marketing): For press staggering: propose partner spotlight blog Thu 14:00, marketplace announcement Thu 15:00, plus 1-hour social push. If any partner needs embargo shift, we handle case-by-case. Also request one-line partner quotes by Tue 12:00.
alex (comms): I'll draft the partner quote template and circulate. Also confirm whether we have a joint press contact list per partner — if not, jamal pls collect.
sara (eng): On staging provisioning — we need the partner workspace IDs and expected model sizes to pre-allocate GPU/instances. If partners will use private deploy variants, call that out.
kevin (si-ops): Noted. Partners A/B/C — I need: 1) contact email, 2) SSO method, 3) sample payload size. Send via DM or add to the checklist doc.
maria (partnerships): Action items: jamal to finish checklist + owners by Tue EOD; tom to deliver hero assets + blog outline by Tue COB; alex to finalize quote template Mon morning; sara + kevin to confirm staging capacity Mon afternoon.
release-bot: CI: scheduled dry-run job created for 4301234567-dryrun at 2025-06-11T08:30:00Z :white_check_mark:
jamal (pm): I'll ping partners and start collecting quotes. If anyone has constraints (embargo, legal signoff delays), please flag here.
tom (marketing): Added draft blog outline to the doc, linked hero images in the assets folder. Need partner logo final PNGs 300x300.
alex (comms): Quick note — keep quotes generic re: performance numbers until Redwood official benchmark is signed off.
sara (eng): Quick smoke test snippet for SI teams to run:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"input":"health-check"}'
```
kevin (si-ops): I'll coordinate SI invites once checklist has workspace IDs. Plan to invite two engineers from each SI to the Fri window.
maria (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll compile a single runbook doc and post final link here by Tue 09:00 PT. If no major blockers by Tue afternoon we'll lock the embargo for Thu 14:00 PT. :thumbsup:
